# Introduction

Use `ggplot2` to recreate the graphs from the Descriptive Statistics application activity.

**NOTICE**: Make each graph presentable by adding titles, axis labels, and adjusting the colors and themes.  

## Load the Libraries and Data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rio)
library(mosaic)
library(car)

student <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/byuistats/Math221D_Cannon/master/Data/student_data_kaggle.csv")

```
